subject: A separately governed invocation-local immutable Git commit observation challenger

clerk.authority: seal the authorized opening court and deterministic DAG only

appeal_authority.authorized_subject: Judge-deferred invocation-scoped immutable Git read batching

baseline.state: the rejected fixture implementation is reverted; existing knowledge and doctor DAG seals remain valid

governing_sources.claim: Material architecture, implementation, learning, and superiority claims require independent court evidence and fail-closed gates.
Executable DAGs require complete node contracts, deterministic rounds, scope isolation, independent integration, and focused worker tests.
The exact doctor command, 180-second timeout, frozen behavior vector, and two-runtime p95 burden are sealed.
The fixture challenger is rejected and a new, separate immutable Git-read challenger court may be opened under mandatory conditions.

atomic_claims.claim: A private immutable invocation-local observation may read a finite set of full commit OIDs in one raw Git batch for diagnostics and pure validation.
The reader must bind repository identity and permitted object storage and fail closed on shallow, graft, promisor, replace, or alternate configurations unless separately proven safe.
One replacement-disabled git cat-file --batch process must validate full OID order/count, type, decimal size, exact bytes/terminator, reconstructed object hash, and commit grammar.
Missing, malformed, duplicate, extra, truncated, reordered, wrong-type, or hash-mismatched output may be accepted partially.
The observation may replace existing Git helpers ambiently or become a generic, ref, HEAD, negative, ancestry, persistent, shared, cross-instance, or cross-invocation cache.
Diff or ancestry conclusions may be derived from delimiter-based batch output in this challenger.
The observation may remain alive across claims, completion, retirement, repair, fetch, push, update-ref, CAS, compensation, or publication.
sealed_recovery.py or release_barrier.py may consume or retain the observation.
A one-trial smoke on each pinned runtime must precede the expensive six-trial qualification matrix.
The unchanged exact doctor gate requires the complete 381-execution vector, every trial below 180 seconds, and nearest-rank p95 at most 135 seconds on both pinned runtimes.
A passing benchmark may automatically promote the candidate, claim superiority, or authorize knowledge BASELINE-000 retry.

authorized_architecture.reader: one narrowly named replacement-disabled git cat-file --batch process over deduplicated validated full commit OIDs
commit_validation: recompute declared-format OID from commit <size> NUL body
exactly one tree followed by zero or more parents before one blank line
only_consumers: explicit invocation-local pure receipt validation in durable_controller
authorized_architecture.effect_boundary: destroy observation, freshly read every mutable fact and authority before effect decision, retain existing CAS/force-with-lease, and freshly verify after effect

frozen_qualification_contract.smoke_policy: exactly one fresh trial per pinned runtime; either non-pass or >=180 seconds stops the six-trial matrix
frozen_qualification_contract.qualification_policy: at least six fresh cold-first alternating trials per runtime; every trial passes below 180 seconds; nearest-rank p95 <=135 seconds
post_performance_gates: independent scope, seal, safety, and rollback receipts

global_forbidden: existing knowledge and doctor DAG or manifest mutation
existing receipt or adverse evidence mutation
rejected candidate or qualification receipt reuse
doctor command, timeout, vector, discovery, or behavior change
generic, ref, HEAD, negative, or ancestry cache
dissent: Batching immutable commit bodies can reduce process overhead, but the retained baseline does not prove Git subprocesses are the dominant end-to-end runtime cause.
A process-local object can still become a semantic cache if it crosses a mutable-state or effect boundary; locality alone is insufficient.
Git repositories with replace, shallow, graft, alternate, promisor, worktree, or non-default object-format configuration need explicit rejection or evidence, not optimistic compatibility.
A passing two-runtime matrix supports only the sealed candidate and cannot establish superiority over unmeasured alternatives.

verdict.final_gate: Only a distinct GCO-JUDGE-090 ADOPT verdict with zero unresolved material findings may authorize the narrowly scoped immutable challenger.

rollback: Revert one node's retained unsquashed integration commit without rebasing or squashing neighbors; retain all externally cited adverse evidence as superseded.
appeal_conditions: new evidence shows the bounded observation crosses an invocation, mutable-state, or effect boundary
repository configuration or object-format cases invalidate the parser or identity binding
either smoke fails or either runtime misses the six-trial completion or p95 burden
the frozen behavior vector, focused safety tests, full .autopilot suite, or full repository CI changes or fails
a narrower or safer separately pinned challenger produces stronger retained evidence
